subject: Renewal paperwork: MSA + order form — triage and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal paperwork: initial bundle + order form

Hi Samir & Lara —

Per our renewal call today, attaching the working MSA and the proposed order form for the 12‑month renewal (includes the 30% capacity uplift we discussed). Please review the redlines and mark any clause that needs business approval (SLA credits, data residency, invoicing cadence).

Summary of what’s attached:
- AcmeHealth-Redline-MSA-v2.docx — our markups (standard platform-level updates)
- OrderForm_Annual_2029.xlsx — capacity table + ramp schedule (rows highlighted where numbers changed)
- Exhibit-D-DataResidency.pdf — proposed clause for EU/US segmentation (placeholder, pending your legal review)

As next steps: if you can return a single redline set to this thread by EOD Friday (or flag the specific bullets), I’ll have Aditya scope legal changes and Karthik confirm capacity scheduling. If procurement needs a separate MSA vs. SOW discussion, loop them in and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to closing the paperwork so we can schedule the capacity add on for Jan.

Mina Haddad
Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: AcmeHealth-Redline-MSA-v2.docx] [attachment: OrderForm_Annual_2029.xlsx] [attachment: Exhibit-D-DataResidency.pdf]

From: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T09:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: initial bundle + order form

Thanks Mina — review in progress. A few early items from legal and procurement:

1) Section 5.2 (data residency) — legal wants stronger guarantees around EU-only processing for EU customers; can you confirm Redwood will commit to EU region processing for all EU accounts in this order?
2) SLA credits — proposal looks fine but procurement requests cap on aggregate credits per year; can we cap at 15% of fees charged in 12‑month term?
3) Order form: row 4 (Q1 ramp) — the uplift number looks higher than commercial discussed (we expected 20% uplift, not 30%). I attached an annotated copy with comments.

I’m looping procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) for billing cadence and PO timing. We’ll aim to get a consolidated redline back by next Wednesday.

-Lara
Lara Gomez
Director, Legal Operations
Acme Health
[attachment: Acme_annotated_orderform.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T13:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: initial bundle + order form

Lara / Samir — thanks for the early flags. I took a pass on the MSA and pulled together suggested language that addresses the EU residency ask while keeping our operational flexibility. Key points:

- Data residency (Sec 5.2): suggested add — "For customers who designate the European Union as the Required Jurisdiction, Redwood will process Customer Data in an EU region and will not export Customer Data outside that region except as strictly necessary and subject to GDPR-compliant safeguards and the Controller/Processor terms in Exhibit D."

- SLA credits cap: we can agree to a caps schedule. Proposed clause: "Aggregate credits issued under this Agreement shall not exceed 15% of Fees paid for the applicable 12‑month period, except where credits are the result of gross negligence or willful misconduct."

- Order form uplift: if Acme expects 20% vs. the 30% in the workbook, we’ll update the order form row and provide an updated capacity ramp schedule. Karthik — can you confirm operational feasibility for a 20% uplift starting Jan 1 and the fallback timeline if traffic is higher?

I’ve attached a tracked‑change MSA (AcmeHealth-Redline-MSA-v3.docx) with the edits above. This should be safe for business signoff pending your review of the EU residency language.

-aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
[attachment: AcmeHealth-Redline-MSA-v3.docx]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-11-05T10:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: initial bundle + order form

Hi Lara / Samir — attached is the updated package: AcmeHealth-Redline-MSA-v3.docx (Aditya's edits incorporated) and a revised order form with the 20% uplift per your note.

Quick notes:
- We accepted the SLA credit cap language Aditya proposed and marked it in redline.
- Data residency language added to Section 5.2; Aditya included the Controller/Processor reference to Exhibit D. If legal wants more prescriptive technical controls (e.g., explicit KMS region bindings), flag here and we’ll scope the Exhibit D update.
- Order form now shows 20% uplift; Karthik is on the thread to confirm the scheduled database/provisioning slot for Jan.

If this looks OK, next step is to have you confirm commercial (PO timing and signatory) and then we’ll send to DocuSign for signature.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>

Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2028-11-07T16:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: initial bundle + order form

Thanks Mina — I reviewed the MSA v3 and the updated order form. Two small asks before we can sign:

1) Exhibit D — legal wants a one‑paragraph summary of controls (encryption at rest/in transit + key management region) added to the Exhibit for procurement peers to validate.
2) Billing cadence — procurement prefers net 60 for the first invoice for the renewal term given internal cycles. Is net 60 acceptable?

Procurement is on the thread to confirm PO timing. If you can add the exhibit paragraph and confirm net 60, we can route to our CFO for signature next week.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Cloud Operations | Acme Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Lara Gomez <lara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-09T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork: initial bundle + order form

Samir — confirmed on capacity: Jan 1 provisioning window works for a 20% uplift on the node pool we discussed. If utilization spikes above plan, we’ll enable auto‑burst (documented in the order form notes) and provision additional capacity within 48 hours of detection.

Net 60 is acceptable for the first invoice for this renewal; finance will emit the invoice with 60‑day terms and we’ll include the PO reference once procurement confirms.

I attached a short checklist for signoff and the DocuSign link for the current MSA/order form package: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-acme-msarenewal

Looking forward to closing. Mina — shall I kick the DocuSign envelope once Aditya and Lara confirm the Exhibit paragraph?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
